{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., >3% error over 3 consecutive days).",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment shifts; lagged sentiment (e.g., 2-3 days prior) should influence correction more than immediate sentiment.",
    "If forecast is consistently higher than true outcome over 5+ days, apply a 10-15% downward adjustment to next forecast horizon.",
    "When sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.33), slightly increase forecast but cap at 10% above recent 7-day average to avoid overcorrection."
  ]
}
